notableFindings: DeFever 34 corrected to 34 Passagemaker (1974-76); generic 45/47/49 records aligned to documented 45 Pilothouse, 47 POC Motor Yacht and 49 Cockpit Motor Yacht.
DeFever 38 retained as unresolved identity rather than forced into a cataloged production model.
Island Gypsy generic 32 overlaps the explicit 32 Sedan record and is flagged for later ID consolidation.
Island Gypsy 50 remains unresolved against the better-documented 49-foot historical variants.
Willard Vega designations are treated as hull families with distinct Nomad, Voyager, Horizon and other configurations.
Prairie 36 lineage to Atlantic 37 is documented; Prairie 29 remains Initial pending stronger primary documentation.
Great Harbour GH37 and N37 share principal dimensions and machinery but materially different layouts.
SeaPiper 35 factory specifications confirm 8 ft 6 in beam and approximately 8 ft 6 in mast-down bridge clearance.
